raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Cosmos3's eager GEN MLPs incur repeated Python and CUDA launch overhead during denoising. On a single GB300, capturing these stateless regions reduces complete-image latency by 7.3–9.0% while preserving eager outputs bit for bit. ## Modifications - Reuse the existing breakable CUDA graph runner for each GEN MLP, with a shared graph pool. Attention and the request-owned UND cache remain eager. - Enable this path with `--enable-breakable-cuda-graph` only for a single CUDA GPU with a resident transformer and `torch.compile` disabled. Rollout remains eager. - Capture during warmup only; serving shape misses use eager execution. Check weight storage and projection dispatch at each request so replaced weights, LoRA wrappers, and step-dependent quantization cannot replay stale graphs. The model module hierarchy and state-dict keys are unchanged. No precision or attention-kernel changes are included. ## Accuracy Tests - 96 generated images across the four SGLang benchmark runs match the corresponding eager output bit for bit, including alternating prompts/seeds. - CUDA tests exercise FP16/BF16, fresh inputs, retained outputs with a shared pool, shape misses, exception cleanup, weight replacement/in-place updates, adapter/quantization fallback, residency gates, and rollout bypass. - After consolidating MLP graph cases into the existing `python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_cosmos3.py`, the Cosmos3, rollout and step-mixed-precision suites pass **172 tests / 73 subtests on GB300** at `2270b82`. No new test file remains; the existing registered diffusion unit bridge collects these cases. - Pre-commit passes on all three changed files. - [Targeted H100 CI](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38147168080) passes all three Cosmos3, rollout and step-mixed-precision partitions at the same head. Model-backed validation covers Cosmos3-Nano T2I. Other Cosmos3 variants and video/transfer workloads have not been benchmarked in this PR; the existing unvalidated-model warning remains. ## Speed Tests and Profiling One GB300, BF16 resident weights, 1024×1024 T2I, 35 steps, CFG 4, three prompts/seeds (42/43/44). Each fresh process performs 9 warmups and 15 measured requests. CPU affinity is fixed to cores 8–15 on NUMA node 0. Cross-request conditioning caching is disabled. Timing covers the native SDK returning a complete CPU image, including text encoding, denoising, VAE, and output transfer; PNG saving is excluded. | Mode | Repeat 1 median | Repeat 2 median | | --- | ---: | ---: | | SGLang eager baseline | 1.493 s | 1.477 s | | SGLang eager + MLP BCG | **1.383 s** | **1.344 s** | | vLLM-Omni + regional torch.compile | 1.549 s | 1.546 s | | Latency reduction vs SGLang eager | 7.3% | 9.0% | | Latency reduction vs Omni compile | 10.7% | 13.1% | Run order: eager → BCG → Omni → Omni → BCG → eager. Omni compilation is verified on all 36 GEN layers, with a nonzero Dynamo graph counter. SGLang uses no torch.compile. Framework environments use their supported PyTorch versions: SGLang 2.14.1+cu130 and Omni 2.13.0+cu130, so the within-SGLang comparison isolates this PR's gain. A separate profile confirms 36 captured MLP graphs and 2,304 actual graph launches per request. Host GatedMLP forward calls fall from 2,376 to 72 (the remaining calls are the UND path). All production captures succeed with no signature misses. Profiling runs are excluded from latency measurements. Tradeoff: SGLang's reported peak memory increases from 35,928 MB to 39,770 MB (+3,842 MB) for this workload. Revisions: SGLang baseline `33d2ef17566685f596b82512e8264456716527f7`; Omni `194b936637f4e7356cc998c2796c67d14d52d854`; `nvidia/Cosmos3-Nano` checkpoint `e59a53c25979a090fa8706c9acc0c254a6e89b92`. ## Generated image comparison Original 1024×1024 PNGs from the measured run, without resizing or editing the image files (only the display width is reduced). Seeds are 42/43/44. The SGLang eager and candidate columns are bit-identical; Omni is shown as a visual reference, not a claim of cross-framework pixel identity. | Prompt / seed | SGLang eager | SGLang MLP BCG | Omni regional compile | |---|---|---|---| | Cyberpunk city / 42 | | | | | Fox in snowy forest / 43 | | | | | Teapot still life / 44 | | | | The exact prompts and per-request hashes are in the linked benchmark harness and records. ## Reproduction [Complete SGLang and vLLM-Omni commands, pinned environments/model revisions, and measurement caveats](https://github.com/BBuf/how-to-optim-algorithm-in-cuda/tree/a03c28c4e30ccd59490bcbc60e61ce51c3d0a50c/artifacts/gb300-diffusion-20261011/README.md); [per-request data and compilation evidence](https://github.com/BBuf/how-to-optim-algorithm-in-cuda/tree/a03c28c4e30ccd59490bcbc60e61ce51c3d0a50c/artifacts/gb300-diffusion-20261011/results). The scripts retain the tested sampling settings and include both stock/candidate and Omni controls. ## Checklist - [x] Format with pre-commit. - [x] Extend existing diffusion tests, collected by the registered diffusion unit bridge. - [x] Provide accuracy and speed results. - [x] Follow SGLang code style. - [ ] Documentation: no new public option; activation and current validation scope are described above. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #38146921504](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38146921504) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #38146921283](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38146921283) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #38146921421](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38146921421)

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Capture stateless Cosmos3 GEN MLPs without capturing the UND cache."""
+
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from functools import wraps
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.breakable_cuda_graph.runner import (
+    BaseBreakableCudaGraphRunner,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.linear import (
+    ColumnParallelLinear,
+    MergedColumnParallelLinear,
+    RowParallelLinear,
+    UnquantizedLinearMethod,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.cosmos3video import (
+    Cosmos3DenseMLP,
+    Cosmos3GatedMLP,
+)
+
+
+class Cosmos3MLPCudaGraphs:
+    """Request-scoped replay over resident, unquantized GEN MLPs.
+
+    MLP inputs contain only visual/audio/action tokens. Their shape does not
+    depend on the text length, and replay copies fresh inputs on every step.
+    Attention and the request-owned UND cache remain eager.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, transformer, device):
+        self.mlps = [layer.mlp for layer in transformer.gen_layers]
+        self.runners = []
+        self._enabled = False
+        self._is_warmup = False
+        self._weight_signature = None
+        pool = torch.get_device_module(device).graph_pool_handle()
+        for mlp in self.mlps:
+            eager = mlp.forward
+            runner = BaseBreakableCudaGraphRunner(eager, device, pool=pool)
+            self.runners.append(runner)
+            mlp.forward = self._wrap_forward(eager, runner)
+
+    def _wrap_forward(self, eager, runner):
+        @wraps(eager)
+        def forward(x):
+            if not self._enabled:
+                return eager(x)
+            if self._is_warmup:
+                runner.capture(x=x)
+            return runner(x=x)
+
+        return forward
+
+    def _get_weight_signature(self):
+        signature = []
+        for mlp in self.mlps:
+            if type(mlp) is Cosmos3GatedMLP:
+                projections = (mlp.gate_up_proj, mlp.down_proj)
+            elif type(mlp) is Cosmos3DenseMLP:
+                projections = (mlp.up_proj, mlp.down_proj)
+            else:
+                return None
+            for projection in projections:
+                # Dynamic LoRA wrappers and step-dependent quant methods must
+                # execute their live Python dispatch, even after warmup.
+                if (
+                    type(projection)
+                    not in (
+                        ColumnParallelLinear,
+                        MergedColumnParallelLinear,
+                        RowParallelLinear,
+                    )
+                    or type(projection.quant_method) is not UnquantizedLinearMethod
+                ):
+                    return None
+                weight = projection.weight
+                if weight.device.type != "cuda" or weight.dtype not in (
+                    torch.float16,
+                    torch.bfloat16,
+                ):
+                    return None
+                signature.append(
+                    (
+                        id(projection),
+                        weight.data_ptr(),
+                        weight.shape,
+                        weight.stride(),
+                        weight.dtype,
+                        weight.device,
+                    )
+                )
+        return tuple(signature)
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def activate(self, *, is_warmup):
+        signature = self._get_weight_signature()
+        if self._weight_signature is not None and signature != self._weight_signature:
+            # Loading a new adapter or replacing weights must not replay a
+            # graph referencing old storage. Serving never recaptures it.
+            for runner in self.runners:
+                runner.reset()
+        self._weight_signature = signature
+        self._enabled = signature is not None
+        self._is_warmup = is_warmup
+        try:
+            yield
+        finally:
+            self._enabled = False
+            self._is_warmup = False

+class _ScaledProjection(nn.Module):
+    """An adapter-like projection with request-dependent Python dispatch."""
+
+    def __init__(self, base):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.base = base
+        self.scale = 2
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        y, bias = self.base(x)
+        return y * self.scale, bias
+
+
+class _StepQuantMethod(UnquantizedLinearMethod):
+    scale = 2
+
+    def apply(self, layer, x, bias=None):
+        return super().apply(layer, x, bias) * self.scale
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "CUDA MLP graphs")
+class TestCosmos3MlpCudaGraphs(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_stage_only_enables_supported_residency_and_execution_mode(self):
+        cases = (
+            (True, False, 1, "resident", True),
+            (False, False, 1, "resident", False),
+            (True, True, 1, "resident", False),
+            (True, False, 2, "resident", False),
+            (True, False, 1, "component-offload", False),
+            (True, False, 1, "layerwise-offload", False),
+        )
+        for enabled, compile_, gpus, residency, expected in cases:
+            with self.subTest(case=(enabled, compile_, gpus, residency)):
+                stage = Cosmos3DenoisingStage.__new__(Cosmos3DenoisingStage)
+                stage._mlp_cuda_graphs = None
+                args = types.SimpleNamespace(
+                    enable_breakable_cuda_graph=enabled,
+                    enable_torch_compile=compile_,
+                    num_gpus=gpus,
+                    canonical_residency_mode=lambda _: residency,
+                )
+                with patch(
+                    "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.breakable_cuda_graph."
+                    "cosmos3_mlp.Cosmos3MLPCudaGraphs"
+                ) as constructor:
+                    stage._maybe_enable_mlp_cuda_graphs(object(), args)
+                    self.assertEqual(constructor.called, expected)
+
+    def test_rollout_does_not_activate_graphs(self):
+        stage = Cosmos3DenoisingStage.__new__(Cosmos3DenoisingStage)
+        stage._mlp_cuda_graphs = Mock()
+        stage._mlp_cuda_graphs.activate.side_effect = AssertionError
+        stage.transformer = object()
+        stage.use_declared_component = Mock(return_value=nullcontext())
+        batch = types.SimpleNamespace(rollout=True, extra={})
+        stage._denoise_once = Mock(return_value=batch)
+        self.assertIs(stage.forward(batch, None), batch)
+        stage._mlp_cuda_graphs.activate.assert_not_called()
+
+    def make_graphs(self, dtype=torch.bfloat16):
+        # No collectives are used by TP=1; keep this a kernel-sized test.
+        group = types.SimpleNamespace(world_size=1, rank_in_group=0)
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.linear.get_tp_group",
+            return_value=group,
+        ):
+            mlps = [Cosmos3GatedMLP(128, 256), Cosmos3DenseMLP(128, 256)]
+        for mlp in mlps:
+            mlp.to(device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+            for weight in mlp.parameters():
+                weight.normal_(std=0.03)
+        transformer = types.SimpleNamespace(
+            gen_layers=[types.SimpleNamespace(mlp=mlp) for mlp in mlps]
+        )
+        eager = [mlp.forward for mlp in mlps]
+        graphs = Cosmos3MLPCudaGraphs(transformer, torch.device("cuda"))
+        self.addCleanup(lambda: [runner.reset() for runner in graphs.runners])
+        return mlps, eager, graphs
+
+    def capture(self, mlps, graphs, x):
+        with graphs.activate(is_warmup=True):
+            for mlp in mlps:
+                mlp(x)
+        self.assertTrue(all(len(r.entries) == 1 for r in graphs.runners))
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_live_inputs_and_retained_outputs(self):
+        for dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
+            with self.subTest(dtype=dtype):
+                mlps, eager, graphs = self.make_graphs(dtype)
+                names = [tuple(mlp.state_dict()) for mlp in mlps]
+                x = torch.randn(1, 64, 128, device="cuda", dtype=dtype)
+                self.capture(mlps, graphs, x)
+                retained = []
+                for _ in range(3):
+                    x.normal_()
+                    expected = [fn(x) for fn in eager]
+                    with graphs.activate(is_warmup=False):
+                        outputs = [mlp(x) for mlp in mlps]
+                    for actual, reference in zip(outputs, expected):
+                        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(actual, reference))
+                        retained.append((actual, reference))
+                for actual, reference in retained:
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(actual, reference))
+                self.assertEqual(names, [tuple(m.state_dict()) for m in mlps])
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def test_serving_miss_and_exception_do_not_capture(self):
+        mlps, eager, graphs = self.make_graphs()
+        x = torch.randn(1, 64, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.capture(mlps, graphs, x)
+        x = torch.randn(2, 33, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        with patch.object(graphs.runners[0], "capture", side_effect=AssertionError):
+            with graphs.activate(is_warmup=False):
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(mlps[0](x), eager[0](x)))
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "request failed"):
+                with graphs.activate(is_warmup=True):
+                    raise RuntimeError("request failed")
+            # An exception must not leave capture enabled outside the request.
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(mlps[0](x), eager[0](x)))
+        self.assertTrue(all(len(r.entries) == 1 for r in graphs.runners))
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()

+        mlps, eager, graphs = self.make_graphs()
+        x = torch.randn(1, 64, 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
